style: 青緑の尾と指差しを共通の美術設定とし、絵の内容と同行先は各場面の本文に従う。

files.prompt_en: A full-body character sprite for a hand-painted fantasy exploration RPG. A single adult mermaid who communicates through drawings, attentive and determined, facing three-quarters toward the viewer. Short dark teal hair swept back behind small fin-shaped ears, warm umber skin, amber eyes, a weathered sea-green linen tunic fastened with a simple woven sash. A long silvery blue-green scaled tail curves gently toward one side and ends in a broad translucent split fin. One hand points deliberately at waist level and the other rests open near the torso. Keep the expressive face, hands, bodice and whole tail legible as one clear silhouette, adaptable to each stage of a conversation. Natural proportions, restrained painted linework, soft directional light, muted colors of oxidized copper, slate and sea glass. Place the torso at the center of a 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas with the crown and both fin tips fully framed and generous transparent margins. The figure and clothing alone form the visible image. The entire surrounding canvas is genuinely transparent.
files.prompt_ja: 手描きの探索RPG用の全身立ち絵。絵を指して意思を伝える成人の人魚が一人、注意深く意志のある表情で斜め正面を向く。暗い青緑の短髪をひれ形の小さな耳の後ろへ流し、温かい褐色の肌と琥珀色の瞳。着古した海緑色の麻の上衣を編み帯で留める。銀色を帯びた青緑の鱗が続く尾は片側へ緩く曲がり、幅広く透ける二つの尾びれで終わる。片手を腰の高さで指す形に伸ばし、もう片方の手は体の近くで開く。顔、指先、上衣、尾全体がひとつの輪郭で読み取れ、会話の各段階に使える姿勢。自然な体の比率、抑えた筆致、柔らかな斜光、緑青、石板、海硝子の落ち着いた色。縦長1024×1536の中央に胴を置き、頭頂と左右の尾びれの先まで収め、周囲に十分な透明の余白を取る。人物と衣装だけが見え、背景は全面が透明。
